test_title: PYST 47 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the sentence given.

When filling out admission forms, it is ______ to fill up our complete names and date of birth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**mandatory**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**mandatory**" means something that is required or compulsory.
 
• When filling out admission forms, it is important to use our full names and accurate date of birth, which is essential for identification and verification purposes.
